6. **`wallet/test/run-wallet.c`**
   - Updated the call from `wallet_channels_load_active` to `wallet_init_channels` in the function that loads channels.

The modifications across the files are interconnected, primarily focusing on the renaming and refactoring of the channel loading functionality. The function `wallet_channels_load_active` was renamed to `wallet_init_channels`, which now encompasses the initialization of the maximum channel database ID and the loading of active channels. This change is reflected in both the wallet header and implementation files, as well as in the peer control logic where channels are loaded.

Additionally, the new test case in `tests/test_db.py` ensures that the changes made to the channel loading logic are functioning correctly, particularly in scenarios involving channel closure and database ID management. Overall, the changes aim to resolve a crash issue related to channel management in the database.

```c
if (!wallet_init_channels(ld->wallet))
```
